marker_text: #[hardwon("#432: equal-span FileScope and module units made service lookups nondeterministic")]
defect: The new synthetic FileScope spans the entire source and is inserted into the same declaration set used by enclosing_code_unit. A Python module declaration spans the same file, but the unchanged min_by_key(span) chooses arbitrarily between equal spans in the hash-backed set. Choosing FileScope prevents module-scope receiver facts from being found and makes ordinary definition lookups intermittently return no definition.

trigger: Index a Python file containing a module-level variable initialized to a class instance and a property/member access on that variable, such as user = User(); user.normalized_name. If the equal-span synthetic FileScope wins iteration over the real module, get_definition_by_location returns no_definition; different workspace/hash iteration orders can change the result.
match_rule: Identify that adding the whole-file FileScope to enclosing lookup creates an equal-span tie with a real Python module and that span-only selection over an unordered set can pick the synthetic owner, losing real module-scope lookup facts. A deterministic tie-break preferring the real declaration, or structurally excluding the synthetic owner when a real one ties, catches the defect.
near_misses: Generic ordering/style complaints, supposed cross-request cache corruption, concurrency in service construction, or FileScope leakage into public symbol lists without the equal-span enclosing-owner selection and wrong lookup result.
why_findable: The intro adds the synthetic whole-file owner and changes enclosing_code_unit to iterate the raw declaration set. Python module declarations and the span-only min are already visible in the same snapshot, so the collision and its effect on owner-based lookup need no later behavior.
notes: Annotation was retrofitted Oct3; actual fix is July1. The issue initially suspected test infrastructure, but the fix identifies an ordinary module-level receiver lookup failure and unignores the service test. No source execution was performed. Base is intro parent.
